question:
Alice, Bob, and Claire are holding a white elephant gift exchange. At the start of the event, they are each holding a present of a different color: Alice has a gold present, Bob has a red present, and Claire has a pink present.
As the event progresses, pairs of people swap gifts. First, Claire and Bob swap their gifts. Then, Claire and Bob swap their gifts. Finally, Claire and Alice swap their gifts. At the end of the event, Claire has the
Options:
(A) gold present
(B) red present
(C) pink present
solution:
Present colors in order (Alice, Bob, Claire):
Initial: (gold, red, pink)
1. Claire and Bob swap: (gold, pink, red)
2. Claire and Bob swap again: (gold, red, pink)
3. Claire and Alice swap: (pink, red, gold)
Claire has the gold present, option (A).
Final answer: (A)
